about.text_0003: Our history, our mission, our values
about.text_0005: The platform that redefines television interaction
about.text_0010: Transform passive television into an interactive and community experience. We connect viewers to the shows they love and other enthusiasts in real time.
about.text_0011: Thanks to our system of QR codes and dedicated chatrooms, each broadcast becomes an opportunity for engagement and dialogue.
about.text_0016: Redefining media interaction by creating the world's largest television engagement platform, where every viewer has a voice and every show has a community.
about.text_0017: We imagine a future where television is no longer a one-way media, but a space for conversation and co-creation.
about.text_0022: Three simple steps to transform your TV experience
about.text_0024: During the broadcast, scan the QR code displayed on the screen with your smartphone
about.text_0026: Give your opinion on the show and justify your choice to help improve the programs
about.text_0031: Exchange in real time with other viewers in the chatroom dedicated to the show
about.text_0035: The principles that guide every feature we develop
about.text_0037: Your data and opinions are protected
about.text_0045: The journey that led us to create CommunityTV
about.text_0047: Birth of the concept following the observation of too passive television. We wanted to create a bridge between broadcasters and their audience.
about.text_0051: Creation of the first version with essential functionalities: dynamic QR codes, chatrooms and survey system.
about.text_0055: Public deployment of CommunityTV with strategic partnerships. The first interactive programs are emerging.
about.text_0060: Constant improvement based on user feedback, with new features such as semantic analyzes and personalized recommendations.
about.text_0064: Some figures that illustrate our growth and impact
about.text_0074: Integrate CommunityTV into your programs and transform your audience
about.text_0076: With CommunityTV, turn your passive viewers into active participants. Get qualitative feedback in real time and create a loyal community around your shows.
about.text_0078: Understand your audience with demographics and semantic analysis
about.text_0080: Generate unique QR codes for each show in just a few clicks
about.text_0082: A technical team at your disposal for integration and maintenance
about.text_0089: Ready to transform your TV experience?
about.text_0090: Join our community and discover the power of real-time interactions
about.text_0094: CommunityTV transformed our show into a real space for dialogue. Engagement increased by 300%!
about.text_0096: Finally a platform that understands the needs of viewers and broadcasters. A revolution!
about.text_0101: A platform created with passion for interactive television.

contact.text_0003: We are here to help you
contact.text_0005: Our Team is available to answer all your questions about Community. Whether for a technical problem, a suggestion for improvement or simply to discuss your survey needs, we are here to help.
contact.text_0007: Several ways to contact us according to your needs:
contact.text_0009: For any technical questions or assistance
contact.text_0015: To report a problem on the platform
contact.text_0018: Complete this form and we will respond to you as soon as possible.
contact.text_0020: What would you like to be called?

contact.text_0024: This helps us process your request more quickly
contact.text_0026: Be as specific as possible for a quick response
contact.text_0032: We are committed to responding to you quickly
contact.text_0043: Quickly find answers to your questions
contact.text_0044: How do I delete my Community account?
contact.text_0045: To delete your account, go to your profile settings, “Account” section. Click on "Delete my account" and confirm your choice. Please note: this action is irreversible and will delete all your surveys and associated data.
contact.text_0046: Can I export my survey results?
contact.text_0047: Yes ! On the Results page of each survey, you will find an "Export" button that allows you to download the data in CSV, JSON or PDF format. Data includes votes, comments and detailed statistics.
contact.text_0048: How many participants can I have in a survey?
contact.text_0049: Community supports up to 10,000 participants per survey. If you need higher capacity for a special event, contact our Sales Team to discuss a custom solution.
contact.text_0051: Absolutely ! Community is fully responsive and works perfectly on smartphones, tablets and computers. You can create, manage and participate in surveys from any device with a modern web browser.
contact.text_0053: Community offers a Free plan to discover the platform, participants stay free, and organizations pay based on audience, team size, and live intensity.
contact.text_0067: Our Support Team is available in chat Monday to Friday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
contact.text_0076: A platform created with passion for quality surveys.
